subject: Game Theory
title: Rubinstein's Alternating Offers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Rubinstein's Alternating Offers usable.

hook.text: You make an offer. I reject it and counter. You reject and counter again. Who blinks first?

buildup.text: Ariel Rubinstein modeled this in 1982: two players alternate offers until one accepts.

discovery.text: Each round of delay costs both sides. The more patient player—the one who discounts less—gets more.

twist.text: The equilibrium is reached instantly: both players know the outcome and agree immediately.

climax.text: In practice, delays happen because real negotiators don't know each other's patience levels.

quiz.question: In Rubinstein's model, who gets the larger share?
